name: SexLikeReal
summary: The primary VR pick: a Netflix-style VR app (SLR app) serving one of the largest VR libraries (74,464 videos from 810 studios, self-reported), with Interactive toys, scripts, live cams, and webcam integration across headsets incl. Quest.
ranking_rationale: Primary VR pick on our own editorial call, backed by first-party pages: the SLR app positions itself as the one-click VR player across every major headset, and its own affiliate page documents the library scale. Price structure aggregates 800+ studios, so site-level price is governed per-studio.

pricing.model: Mixed — pay-per-video, per-studio memberships, and pass plans; governed per studio
pricing.notes: Aggregator reports put premium around $–$/mo with conflicting figures; not accepted wholesale — the site itself prices per studio/video. Verify in checkout.

pros: Largest library claim is its own, not a tracker’s — and consistent with the VR hub’s coverage
cons: Per-studio pricing maze: subscriptions do not cover everything
Site-level price unverified at check time
